about_the_game:
Off the Beaten Track is a couch/online multiplayer party game for 2–4 players, where a roster of unique characters, each with their own weapons and abilities, clash in intense versus matches across varied space arenas filled with environmental hazards.

Play casually with friends or go head-to-head in skillful competitive showdowns. Easy to pick up but hard to master, every fight rewards reflexes, strategy, and clever use of your character’s specific tools.

Key Features

  • Couch/online multiplayer for 2–4 players

  • A roster of unique characters with their own tools, playstyle, and personality

  • A wide array of weapons and abilities: rockets, lasers, mines, stun, fear, stasis, vampirism, slow, poison, knockback, and more

  • Multiple cosmic arenas, including secret ones, filled with hazards: from freezing icy planets and electrified asteroids to lightning-shooting crystals, deadly black holes, and massive monsters

  • Accessible arcade controls with real skill-based depth

  • Perfect for party nights, rivalries, and rematches
